newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEPCO buys LSWR from LG-Caltex, Vitol, Daewoo Corp.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO buys LSWR from LG-Caltex, Vitol, Daewoo Corp.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Corp has (KEPCO) awarded its tender to buy 2 million barrels of low sulphur waxy residue (LSWR) for January and February at between $2.39 and $5.09 per barrel premia over Singapore spot quotes, a company official said on Tuesday.
KEPCO bought a 40,000-barrel cargo from South Korean refiner LG-Caltex Oil Corp, a unit of LG Group, for delivery between January 6-10 at $5.09 per barrel premia over Singapore published quotes.
It purchased two 60,000-barrel cargoes from Dutch trader Vitol - a January 11-15 cargo at a premia of $3.09 and a February 14-18 cargo at $2.39 per barrel.
KEPCO also purchased another 40,000-barrel cargo for delivery February 4-5 at $2.58 premia over Singapore spot quotes from Daewoo Corp, a trading arm of South Korea's Daewoo Group.
All cargoes are priced on a cost and freight basis for delivery to Ulsan, Pusan or Inchon, the official said.
The tender closed December 9 and was valid until December 14.
KEPCO last purchased 400,000 barrels of LSWR at $1.91 per barrel over Singapore spot quotes for November 5-9 delivery.
